newsitem.title: DENMARK: Moeller seeks India oil partner.
newsitem.headline: Moeller seeks India oil partner.

text.p: Danish shipping, oil and gas group A.P. Moeller is negotiating with a potential joint venture partner to start oil and gas prospecting in India, Lloyds List newspaper said on Tuesday.

"We expect to sign a (fifty-fifty) joint venture agreement (with a local partner) soon and we are in any case conducting a study of geological data at the Bombay High V field," Moeller director Per Joergensen told the paper.
"India will be a focus area for us in the coming years," Joergensen said.
